newsitem.title: USA: Dal-Tile sees additional costs of $0.05/shr.
newsitem.headline: Dal-Tile sees additional costs of $0.05/shr.

text.p: Dal-Tile International said on Thursday it is expecting additional operating costs of about $4.5 million or $0.05 per share per quarter in each of the first two quarters of 1997.
The company attributed the additional costs to falling behind its original timetable for integrating its operating systems after the acquisition of American Olean Tile Co.
"Additionally, the company could experience some impact on revenue growth until systems integration is completed," Dal-Tile said in a release.

The company expected to begin realising benefits from an integrated system in the first quarter of 1997, but said on Thursday that it believes the systems integration will not be completed until the second half of the year.
Wall Street is expecting the company to report earnings of $0.30 for the fourth quarter and $0.93 for the year, according to First Call consensus estimates.
The company said it will report its earnings late in the week of February 17.
